prompt:
Fit the existing synthetic neutral body proxy to target-front-mask.png and target-side-mask.png using generator.py and initial-params.json. Execute a constrained parameter fit with the frozen camera and 170 cm height prior. Export fitted params, actual OBJ, front/side/back previews, initial/final per-view silhouette metrics and a short evidence/uncertainty report. Use only the two masks as target evidence; do not invent observed side/back photographs or anatomical truth.

Save top-level fitted.obj, params.json, initial-front-mask.png, initial-side-mask.png, final-front-mask.png, final-side-mask.png, front.png, side.png, back.png, front-overlay.png, side-overlay.png, metrics.json (initial/final by view), report.md and runnable reproduce.py. If names differ explain in report. Metrics should include IoU, Dice, mean and P95 symmetric contour distance in pixels. Do not read any oracle or other run.
All work is authorized on these synthetic controlled fixtures. Use existing local Python/browser capabilities; do not invoke image generation or external paid services. Execute the work; a plan alone is not completion.
